summary: 2026 UCI WorldTeam kit by Pissei, launched 12 December 2025; read from the club's still-life front/back jersey, bib and skinsuit views in the launch media pack. Chest and mid-back: UAE TEAM EMIRATES XRG (Emirates title, XRG co-title since 2025). FAB and e& on the chest, e& also on the collar and upper back, Analog across the shoulders, Richard Mille along the collar, FAB/ADQ stacked on the sleeves, MyWhoosh on the back shoulders, G42 and the Colnago clover on the shorts, IHC on the shorts' seat, Emirates blocks on sleeve cuffs and shorts hems, a '#WeAreUAE' slogan under the rear pockets. Pissei makes the kit (listed as sponsor on the club site); the UCI 'WorldTour Best Team 2025' mark is an award, not a sponsor.
